camel_example: aliyun cloudfw CreateWebFilterTemplate --region cn-hangzhou --Status Enable --Name 'Web过滤模板01'
description_en: Creates a web filtering template. The template is at the user granularity and can be referenced by access control policies of Internet, NAT, and virtual private cloud (VPC) firewalls. Web filtering rules can be added to the template. Before creating a template, ensure that the web filtering feature is enabled and the number of templates does not exceed the instance quota
description_zh: 创建Web过滤模板。模板为用户粒度，可被互联网、NAT、VPC边界防火墙的访问控制策略引用，模板内可添加Web过滤规则。创建前需已开通Web过滤功能，且模板数量未超过实例规格配额
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-web-filter-template --name 'Web过滤模板01' --status Enable --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateWebFilterTemplate

parameters.help_en: The name of the web filtering template. The name must be 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). It cannot contain spaces or be empty
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板名称。长度为1~64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.），不能包含空格，不能为空
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the web filtering template. Valid values:
Enable: enabled.
Disable: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Web过滤模板的状态。取值：
Enable：开启。
Disable：关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.example: 用于URL访问管控的Web过滤模板
parameters.help_en: The description of the web filtering template. The description can be up to 128 characters in length and can be empty
parameters.help_zh: Web过滤模板的描述信息。长度不超过128个字符，可以为空
parameters.name: description

WebFilterTemplateId.description_en: The ID of the newly created web filtering template
